About the Program

The campus ambassador's responsibilities include:
1. Connect with current students and alumni across colleges.
2. Encourage genuine college reviews on academics, placements, fees, faculty and campus life.
3. Introduce students to CollegeReviewz and its review-sharing platform.
4. Conduct student awareness and digital outreach activities through appropriate campus communities.
5. Share their unique referral links with interested students.
6. Track verified reviews and share progress updates with the team.
7. Promote honest, original feedback without influencing ratings.

Skill(s) required

English Proficiency (Spoken) English Proficiency (Written)
Earn certifications in these skills
Learn Business Communication

Who can apply

Only those candidates can apply who:

1. can start the part time job/internship between 25th Nov'26 and 30th Dec'26

2. are available for duration of 1 month

3. have relevant skills and interests

Other requirements

1. We welcome students and graduates from all academic backgrounds and colleges across India.

2. Freshers are welcome. No previous internship experience is required.

Rewards and incentives
1. The campus ambassador must complete onboarding, share the official CollegeReviewz review form in their college/student groups, collect at least 15 genuine and verifiable student reviews/responses, and submit one weekly progress report. Fake, copied, forced, or irrelevant reviews will not be counted.
2. The minimum assured reward will be Rs 500 + an internship certificate after successful completion of the above task and verification by the CollegeReviewz team.
3. Perks: Flexible hours.

About CollegeReviewz.com

CollegeReviewz.com is a rapidly growing education technology platform focused on building a reliable and student-first ecosystem for college information and reviews across India. The platform aims to empower students with verified data, authentic peer reviews, and transparent insights to help them make informed academic and career decisions. CollegeReviewz.com is developing a national-scale college discovery and comparison platform that provides verified college profiles, honest student reviews, detailed insights on placements, fees, facilities, and cutoffs, along with real campus experiences shared through social media and video content, with the vision of becoming a trusted destination for students, parents, and educators seeking guidance on college admissions and higher education choices.
